expected_output.reasoning:
The expected output requires a completed, substantive report: an audit of the user's IAM policies and access keys, a determination of what each credential can do in Bedrock (with grant/risk tier), a recommended first action with documentation link, a clear distinction between 'what credentials can do' vs 'what they did' (emphasizing GetAccessKeyLastUsed only shows last AWS call, not Bedrock-specific use, and that actual invocation history comes from GuardDuty/CloudTrail), a statement that the audit is read-only and changed nothing, masking of the key ID to last 4 chars, and ending without an offer/follow-up question.

The agent's actual response is merely a status update saying it has 'started two checks in parallel' and will produce a report 'when both finish.' It contains none of the required substantive content: no IAM policy findings, no Bedrock permission grants, no risk tiers, no recommended first action, no documentation link, no discussion of the distinction between capability and actual usage, no statement about read-only/no changes, no masked key ID. It is essentially a placeholder/interim response, not the final deliverable described in the expected output. This fails nearly every criterion of the expected output.
expected_output.evidence: "I've started two checks in parallel... I'll pull them into one report with the first action to take when both finish."
